Name: Texas Longhorn
Author: rlgenung
Description:
This replaces white cows and baby white cows with awesome Texas Longhorn cows!

I know that Texas Longhorns are not a milking breed but I wanted my state’s large mammal on my farm, so go with it.
I made this mod to go along with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/60/?]gglacier’s Wee Highland Coos mod[/url] since Highlands are my favorite breed and I wanted the whites to be just as “wild-like”. *shrug* 


Install
1. Backup the original White Cow.xnb and BabyWhite Cow.xnb
2. Unzip the file
3. Place the new .xnb files into your StardewValley\Content\Animals folder. This will overwrite the original. Answer "yes"
to any overwrite messages. 

Uninstall
1. Put the original xnbs back into the \Content\Animalsfolder and overwrite the mod files
